description: Election Commission - Declare that S. V. Nihal as a Member of the Weligama Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Weligama Urban Council) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new council member by the political party and returning officer, making it clearly related to electoral processes and local government elections.
